budget_comparability.attribution_rule: No improvement is attributed to the stable kernel by this harness. Budget comparability requires equal requested work; any one-contract-only admission refusal remains a reported KIND difference.

budget_comparability_argument: Budget comparability: legacy admits max_evaluations 2..16 per annulus with aggregate <= 128 per rotor; the stable contract admits 2..32 per annulus with aggregate <= 256. This declared family pins max_evaluations 16 for every annulus, worst case 8x16=128, so every case is admitted identically under both contracts and the stable higher ceilings are never exercised: measured convergence differences on this family cannot be explained by allowed work. Actual residual evaluations used are reported per case per solver alongside convergence counts.

caps.scope: Per case: both evaluators, deep copies, raw retention and parent response checks; CPU is child plus parent. Final receipts/log/manifest generation is outside the cap.

boundary_contract.binding: native root hash; child request hash binds reconstructed full derived V135 request
boundary_contract.calls: one actual V135 call per annulus, immediate bounded copy; no model rerun by guard
boundary_contract.counts: fully guarded whole children only, including OOD/nonconverged; never attempts
boundary_contract.failure: SOLVE_BOUNDARY_FAILED clears all payload; counts omit entire current child
boundary_contract.guard: fresh frozen V135 catalog; full pure residual guards and independent ordered trace replay
boundary_contract.nonconverged: run all annuli; retain full traces; no integrated totals unless all CONVERGED

calculations.arithmetic: checked binary64 finite normal or zero; refuse nonzero product underflow
calculations.cancellation: signed contributions allowed; fsum zero of rounded inputs allowed, no physical claim
calculations.integration: selected actual all-blade V133 dT/dr and dQ/dr times dr, no extra blade factor
calculations.source: Drela QPROP equations 64-65; midpoint rule; Omega Q shaft-power denominator in eq. 66

hash_contract.evaluation: SHA256 full response excluding only evaluation_sha256; not authenticity or attestation
hash_contract.exceptions: ordinary Exception sanitized; BaseException propagates; persistent hashing failure clears both hashes
hash_contract.request: SHA256 full original native snapshot; sorted compact UTF8 JSON; ensure_ascii=False, allow_nan=False

limitations: Experimental nonlinear isolated axial rotor with prescribed finite annuli only.
Hub cutoff is explicit; no hub-loss model or radial/rotor interaction model.
Midpoint quadrature has no discretization error estimate or numerical qualification.
Signed thrust, torque and shaft power do not establish motor or DC/regen feasibility.
No API, UI, dataset fetch, mission, motor, publication or rotor-data validation.
Geometry and polar sources are unverified caller assertions; no redistribution claim.
Counts admit only fully guarded whole section solves, including nonconverged/OOD solves.
Hashes bind native JSON, not runtime identity, provenance authenticity or physical truth.
Experimental bounded local bisection of actual V134 residuals only.
Numerical convergence requires residual tolerance and bracket width; no root error bound.
Exact binary64 residual zero is not proof of an exact mathematical root.
Sampled sign change does not establish continuity or continuous polar coverage.
No interpolation of residuals, constant-Cl iteration, extrapolation or recovery from OOD.
No blanket Ning convergence guarantee, feasibility claim or physical validation.
No API, UI, dataset, publication, nonlinear rotor solver or rotor integration.
Counts mean fully guarded accepted children including OOD, never attempts or attestation.
Hashes bind native JSON; they do not authenticate data, runtime identity or physical claims.
Unexpected V134 failures are RESIDUAL_BOUNDARY_FAILED without trusting their causes.
Experimental local prescribed-psi circulation residual only; no derivative or root claim.
Ua and Ut exclude this rotor's own induction; only the positive induction branch is admitted.
Tip, hub, windmill and reverse-flow operation are excluded.
Non-contracting constant-pitch helical wake assumption; strictly valid only for lightly-loaded Goldstein circulation.
Modified Prandtl factor is empirical; no CFD, physical validation or numerical qualification.
Caller polar source, classification, uncertainty and Mach applicability remain UNVERIFIED.
No external dataset, source fetching, API, UI, rotor solver or integration.
Checked binary64 arithmetic can refuse representational extremes; no full-range promise or hidden F limit.
Nested V132 guard is reused; V133 kinematics, loads and complete root are reconstructed independently.
Counts mean fully guarded child results, including OOD; not attempts, physical evidence or attestation.
Hashes bind full native JSON, not authenticity, runtime identity, physical validity or feasibility.
Unexpected child failure is sanitized as LOAD_BOUNDARY_FAILED without trusting child failure causes.

request_contract.annuli: 1..8 contiguous full-native-exact boundaries from positive hub to tip
request_contract.branch: V>=0, blade_count exact int 1..64, pitch in [0,pi/2]; V135 branch inherited
request_contract.geometry: native and float inner<outer; checked dr and strict interior midpoint
request_contract.numbers: builtin int/float, finite normal or zero; positive radii/chord/omega/properties
request_contract.polar: exact V132 polar contract; all applicability and source assertions unverified
request_contract.preflight: all derived actual V135 requests, both endpoints, before any model call
request_contract.schema: exact evaluation/rotor/annuli; exact rotor and annulus fields; no defaults

status_matrix.COMPUTED_EXPERIMENTAL: all guarded children; COMPUTED or NOT_RUN_SECTION_NOT_CONVERGED
status_matrix.EXECUTION_FAILED: atomic empty payload; prior accepted counts; hashes when export succeeds
status_matrix.MODEL_INAPPLICABLE: invalid static request; no calls, zero counts and null hashes

boundary_contract.admission: Raw intrinsic+remaining quota stream checks, copy, remeasure/exact compare, full guard, commit quota, then counts.
boundary_contract.counts: Section solves int0..8; residual/load/lookup equal sums of fully guarded whole solves int0..256; not attempts.
boundary_contract.export: Separate root128MiB/16777216-node ceiling; requests/wrappers/units extra; prehash and postseal checked.
boundary_contract.failure: Atomic empty outputs/units; SOLVE_BOUNDARY_FAILED or STABLE_POLAR_ROTOR_EXECUTION_FAILED with prior counts.
boundary_contract.guard: Fresh frozen exact V140 catalog; independent ordered trace engine, accepted V140 residual guard only in residual scope.
boundary_contract.nonconverged: Accepted computed nonconverged/OOD child retained; all annuli still called; integration null.
boundary_contract.oracle: No solve evaluator/_bisect or producer numerical helper used for trace replay.
boundary_contract.qualification: Configured byte/node ceilings are not RAM/API/time/concurrency proofs; probes and independent acceptance pending.
boundary_contract.quota: Sum canonical WHOLE returned child objects, including units/metadata/hashes; <=64MiB and8388608 nodes.
boundary_contract.refusal: Quota exception => RESOURCE_BUDGET_EXCEEDED; no parent copy/hash/guard of that rejected child; prior whole counts only.
boundary_contract.upstream: Child has already allocated/hashed its returned result; quota does not prevent upstream allocation.

calculations.arithmetic: Checked normal-or-zero binary64; nested V140 bound alone permits positive finite subnormal.
calculations.eligibility: All children CONVERGED or ALL contributions/integrated null with not_applicable units.
calculations.integration: Selected actual all-blade V133 dT/dr,dQ/dr times dr; no extra blade count.
calculations.totals: Ordered signed contributions summed with fsum; shaft_power_w=Omega*total_torque_nm.

hash_contract.evaluation: SHA256 full bounded response excluding only evaluation_sha256; data binding, not authenticity.
hash_contract.exceptions: Ordinary Exception sanitized; BaseException propagates; persistent export/hash fault clears payload/both hashes, retains counts.
hash_contract.request: SHA256 full validated native request: policy/geometry/all polar bytes/budgets; sorted compact UTF8 ensure_ascii=False allow_nan=False.
